From: Fenech, Anthony
Sent: Saturday, June 9, 2018 3:11 PM
To: dave.dangler@detroittigers.com <dave.dangler@detroittigers.com>
Subject: Hugh Smith/Tarik Skubal 
 
Hello Dave,

Anthony Fenech from the Detroit Free Press here. Hope the draft went well for you. Do you know who Smith and Skubal's agents are? Also, working on a write-up on some of the lesser-known guys drafted. If you have a short scouting report on him, send it my way. No quotes.
